ExecutionForms_CodeSystemVersionId.description: Strongly-typed UUIDv7 identifier for an immutable, checksum-verified release of a code system in the Concept Registry.

ExecutionForms_NullFlavor.description: Why a value is missing (HL7 null flavors, narrowed to the ones clinical data collection uses).

ExecutionForms_ObservationValue.description: The value of a recorded clinical fact (spec §8.1, K-FACT-2, K-FACT-3, ADR-2623): exactly one of a quantity with its UCUM unit, a code from a pinned code-system version, text, a boolean, an ISO 8601 date or time at the precision it was known, or a reasoned absence. It is the value as entered: a normalised unit, a standardised result or a decoded label is a derivation of it, never a replacement (K-FACT-2).

code_system_version_id.description: The code-system version the code was chosen from.

code.description: The code, exactly as the code system writes it.

ExecutionForms_ObservationValueCodedValu.description:
A code from one pinned code-system version (spec §6.1), such as an NCI CT submission value in CDISC CT 2025-09-26 or
a LOINC answer code. The version is part of the value, so the same code read years later still means what it meant.

precision.description: How precisely the date or time is known, or null when string DateTimeValue.Value is not valid ISO 8601.

ExecutionForms_ObservationValueDateTimeV.description:
An ISO 8601 date or date and time at the precision it was known (ISO 8601-1 reduced precision): `2026`,
`2026-03`, `2026-03-14`, `2026-03-14T09:30` or `2026-03-14T09:30:15`. A time may carry <!-- deid-ignore: ISO 8601 format examples, not PHI -->`Z` or an offset; without one it is the local time where it was observed. A partial date is never padded to a
full one.

detail.description: More about why, such as the reason a test was not done (SDTM `--REASND`); optional.

ExecutionForms_ObservationValueMissingVa.description:
A value that was not obtained, with why (K-FACT-3): the test was not done, the answer is unknown, the question does
not apply, and so on. It is a recorded fact in its own right, corrected like any other value.

unit.description: The UCUM unit expression, case-sensitive; `1` for a dimensionless quantity.

oneOf.description: For a bound, how the true amount relates to Value; null for an exact amount.

ExecutionForms_ObservationValueQuantityV.description:
A measured amount in the UCUM unit it was entered in (K-FACT-2), such as 120 `mm[Hg]`, with an optional
comparator for a bound such as <0.5 `mg/dL`. The decimal keeps the precision it was entered with (1.50 stays
1.50).

ExecutionForms_ObservationValueTextValue.description: Free text as entered, such as a verbatim adverse event term.
